params.caption: 🎮 GTA 6 will have its own in-game cartoon show: Macca & Friends GTA 6 is launching with a full Saturday-morning-style animated series that players can watch on in-game TV. The show is called Macca & Friends, and a teaser trailer for it is already out. It's another sign of how much side content Rockstar is packing into Leonida. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 19:39 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Dexerto 👥 @RockstarGames 📺 React if you'd actually sit and watch it · 💬 Best GTA TV show ever? #GTA6 #RockstarGames #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
